description_en: Modifies the attributes of an endpoint
description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute接口，修改终端节点的属性
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink update-vpc-endpoint-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint that you want to modify. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的终端节点的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request without performing the update gateway endpoint attribute operation. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改终端节点属性。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to modify
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the endpoint.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点的名称。

名称长度在2~128个字符之间，以英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: endpoint_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the endpoint.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点的描述。

描述长度为2~256个字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: endpoint_description

parameters.help_en: The RAM access policy. For more information about the policy definition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html
parameters.help_zh: RAM权限策略。关于策略定义的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html
parameters.name: policy_document

parameters.help_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
DualStack: dual-stack.
To enable dual-stack for the endpoint, the endpoint service connected to the endpoint and the VPC in which the endpoint resides must both support dual-stack
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型。
终端节点支持双栈，要求其连接的终端节点服务及终端节点所处的VPC均支持双栈
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable nearest access for the endpoint domain name of the connected service. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持连接服务的终端节点域名就近解析，取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zone_affinity_enabled

parameters.help_en: Resets the policy to the default policy
parameters.name: reset_policy

parameters.help_en:
The cross-region bandwidth. This parameter is required only when the endpoint and the endpoint service are in different regions. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

Minimum value: 100.
Maximum value: limited by the quota of the current account. For more information, see Quotas and limits (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/privatelink/quotas-and-limits).
Before you specify this parameter, make sure that the endpoint is a cross-region endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域带宽值，仅当终端节点和终端节点服务跨地域时涉及该参数。单位：Mbps。取值：

最小值：100。
最大值：受限于当前账号的配额（具体数值请参见配额与限制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/privatelink/quotas-and-limits?spm=a2c4g.11174283.help-menu-search-120462.d_0)章节）。
如需指定该参数，请确保您操作的是跨地域的终端节点
parameters.name: cross_region_bandwidth
